statement.text: The quadratic 2 type of a 4-manifold M is the data $(\pi_{1}(M), \pi_{2}(M), \lambda_{M}, k_{M})$ of the fundamental group $\pi_{1}(M)$, the second homotopy group $\pi_{2}(M)$ considered as $a \mathbb{Z}[\pi_{1}(M)]-module$, the equivariant intersection for $m \lambda_{M}$, and the k-invariant in $k_{M} \in H^{3}(B\pi_{1}(M);\pi_{2}(M))$. Which quadratic 2-types are realized by closed, oriented topological 4-manifolds? Which are realized by closed, oriented, smooth 4-manifolds? Can this problem be solved for specific fundamental groups, for example for certain families of non-cyclic finite groups?
